g.text: One iximiuz Labs playground • containers only • member-local storage
Tailscale is the client access boundary
each has Incus, OVN, Open vSwitch and its own disk
Replication and Geneve use eth0, not Tailscale.
Btrfs is local to each host: data is not synchronously replicated.
Incus HTTPS listens on 0.0.0.0:8443; management clients use Tailscale addresses.
